newsitem.title: UK: GRAYSTONE SAYS BID APPROACH TALKS STILL ON.
newsitem.headline: GRAYSTONE SAYS BID APPROACH TALKS STILL ON.

text.p: British engineering and components distribution group Graystone Plc said on Thursday talks on a bid approach which the company had received were continuing and it remained unclear whether they would lead to an offer being made.
Graystone had announced on July 16 that it had received a possible bid that could lead to an offer at a significant premium to the current market value.
The share price of the company had moved up from 56 pence since then to 81 1/2 p on Thursday.
The company, however, said it was also in exclusive negotiations with a proposed bidder to sell the engineering companies within the group.
Graystone said it was hoping to exchange contracts to sell those companies at a price "consistent with the board's expectations" by September 30, 1997.
